name: Java Bytecode Disassembler
description: Java Bytecode Architecture + Java Class File BinaryView
longdescription: Loads Java `.class` files (magic 0xCAFEBABE) as a BinaryView, exposes a `JVM` architecture that disassembles and (partially) lifts JVM bytecode to LLIL, and parses the full class-file structure (constant pool, fields, methods, attributes) into Binary Ninja types. Python 3 port of Pusty/BinaryNinjaPlugins binary-jvm.
author: Pusty (Python 3 port: patrick)
